summary: Marks an entity that a script moves to a target; created by the per-frame update of esv::script::MoveToTargetSystem (bg3.exe+0x2EA7090) for each entity of its pending list when missing, before the move request (0x14-byte records) is handed to a virtual handler.

fields.name: RequestId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EA73A0 allocates 4 bytes and writes 0. Toolkit esv::script::MoveToTargetSystem::UpdateRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x55FBF0) passes the component pointer as the uint& out-parameter of MoveToTargetHelper::MoveToTarget (EoCServer.dll+0x55F720), which hands it to esv::BehaviourMachine::SetState(..., uint* param_3, ...) (EoCServer.dll+0xA6CB00: writes 0 or the id of the behaviour state request); for entities whose move is no longer pending it reads the 4-byte value (column stride 4) and passes it to the helper's stop slot (+0x10) before removing the component. Windows bg3.exe+0x2EA7090 lines 146-148 read the same 4-byte value (stride 4) for that slot. Name inferred: the id of the move behaviour request.

second_pass: Toolkit MoveToTargetSystem::UpdateRequests / MoveToTargetHelper::MoveToTarget show the 4 bytes are the uint request id returned by BehaviourMachine::SetState and later used to stop the move; the Windows update bg3.exe+0x2EA7090 reads the same 4-byte value.
